kill_chain_signals.contact: automated messaging and encrypted communication tools used to contact large numbers of people quickly; unsolicited job offers through social media messaging apps or text messages
kill_chain_signals.pretext: perpetrators pose as employers with realistic job postings, interviews, and official-looking documents; professional-looking websites or apps claiming to offer investment opportunities
kill_chain_signals.payment: victims asked to move money, accept payments in personal bank account, or use crypto; money deposited into fake investment platforms
kill_chain_signals.movement: malicious apps used to move money without the victim's knowledge; victims pressured to invest more or pay additional fees
kill_chain_signals.cashout: victims find they cannot withdraw their funds; criminals move funds quickly and anonymously through crypto investments or fraudulent payment systems

red_flags: Unsolicited job offers through social media messaging apps or text messages
Asked to download apps or software as part of a job offer
Asked to move money, accept payments in personal bank account, or use crypto as part of job
Investment opportunities promising guaranteed or unusually high returns
Pressure to act quickly or keep the opportunity secret
